title: Neural Network Surrogate Modeling for 2D Heat Diffusion: Accuracy, Rollout Stability, and Physics-Informed Training
description: Complete implementation of a CNN surrogate for 2D transient heat diffusion. Includes finite-difference solver, dataset generation, baseline CNN training, autoregressive rollout evaluation, physics-informed training, generalization experiments, and ablation studies. Companion code for the paper submitted August 2026.
